source: NCERT Class VII, Our Environment, Geography Ch. 5.

sections.heading: 1. Water on Earth
points: About **71%** of the Earth's surface is water — the 'Blue Planet'.
**~97%** is **salty ocean water**; only about **3%** is **fresh water**, and most of that is frozen in **glaciers and ice caps** — so usable fresh water is very limited.
The **water cycle** keeps water moving between oceans, air and land (evaporation → condensation → precipitation).

sections.heading: 2. Movements of Ocean Water
points: Ocean water is never still; it moves in three ways: **waves, tides and currents**.

sections.heading: 3. Waves and Tides
points: **Waves** — caused by **winds** blowing over the sea surface; strong waves cause **coastal erosion**.
A **tsunami** is a huge wave usually caused by an **undersea earthquake/volcano** (not a normal wind wave).
**Tides** — the **rise and fall of sea water** twice a day, caused by the **gravitational pull of the Moon (and Sun)**.
**Spring tides** — highest tides, at **full moon and new moon** (Sun, Moon, Earth in a line).
**Neap tides** — lowest tides, when Sun and Moon are at **right angles** (first/last quarter). Tides help in **fishing, navigation and generating tidal energy**.

sections.heading: 4. Ocean Currents
points: **Currents** = streams of water flowing **continuously** in a definite direction.
**Warm currents** flow from the **equator towards the poles** (e.g. **Gulf Stream**); **cold currents** flow from the **poles towards the equator** (e.g. **Labrador Current**).
Where **warm and cold currents meet**, they create the world's **richest fishing grounds** (e.g. near **Japan / Newfoundland**), and often **fog**.

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: 97% ocean (salty); ~3% fresh (mostly frozen) → little usable fresh water.
Ocean movements: waves, tides, currents.
Waves = wind-caused; tsunami = undersea earthquake; tides = Moon's gravity.
Spring tides = full/new moon (highest); neap tides = quarter moons (lowest).
Warm current = equator→poles (Gulf Stream); cold = poles→equator (Labrador); their meeting = rich fishing grounds.

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: A **tsunami** is caused by an **undersea earthquake/volcano**, not by wind.
**Tides** are caused mainly by the **Moon's gravitational pull**.
**Spring tides** (highest) occur at **full and new moon**; **neap tides** (lowest) at the quarters — 'spring' has nothing to do with the season.
**Warm currents** move **away from the equator**; **cold currents** move **towards it**.
